ns2:section.sectionText: Students earning at least an A- in Math 447 or doing well in Math 424 and who will have completed Math 415 or 416 by the end of the term should e-mail mathadvising@illinois.edu <mailto:mathadvising@illinois.edu> with name, netid, UIN, and request for approval to register for Math 425. Students doing well in Math 425 in the spring term will be given special consideration for approval to take Math 518, Differentiable Manifolds I, for the fall term. Note: Attendance may be required at the scheduled meeting times.
